content.short: Bond Protocol enables on-chain capital raises via permissionless bond markets.
content.description: Bond Protocol enables projects to tap into markets that help secure protocol-owned liquidity, broaden treasury diversification, and acquire strategic assets, while giving community members fair access to capital raises in exchange for vested tokens from the projects they back. By tokenizing bonds and employing a modular architecture, Bond Protocol can underpin sophisticated DeFi systems and applications that rely on auctions or vesting token issuance.
